description: Defines the WKProvisionalPage class which manages a provisional web page in WebKit, handling network requests, frame attachment, and event listeners within the WebKit protocol implementation.

classes.name: WKProvisionalPage
classes.description: Manages a provisional page in WebKit, handling network events, frame attachment, and request management during page navigation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a WKProvisionalPage instance, sets up event listeners, and starts session initialization.

methods.name: coopNavigationRequest
methods.description: Returns the current COOP navigation request, if any.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all event listeners associated with this provisional page.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Attaches the main frame to the page after initialization.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a network request is about to be sent, possibly adopting a request if it matches the COOP navigation request.

methods.name: _onLoadingFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when loading finishes, clearing the COOP request.

methods.name: _onLoadingFailed
methods.description: Handles loading failure events, clearing the COOP request.

methods.name: _handleFrameTree
methods.description: Sets the main frame ID based on the frame tree structure.
